actions.action: Group names by rationale, not just wording
actions.mechanism: Separate underlying directions from wording variants so similar names can represent different intentions without erasing their origins.
actions.implementation: Add rationale and addressed-constraint fields. Allow suggestions in multiple labeled direction groups; retain immutable originals and privately recorded authorship through merges.
actions.check: Submit two similar names with different rationales. Verify both directions remain visible and each original is recoverable after grouping.
actions.risk: Overlapping groups may require manual clarification.

actions.action: Make rejections depend on versioned constraints
actions.mechanism: A rejection references the constraint version that justified it, allowing changed requirements to reopen the discussion.
actions.implementation: Require a rejection explanation and linked constraint or explicit other reason. When a linked constraint changes, mark the rejection for reconsideration without deleting history.
actions.check: Reject a name for exceeding three words; raise the limit. Verify its rejection is flagged for review, not silently reversed.
actions.risk: Frequent edits could produce excessive reconsideration notices.

actions.action: Give late suggestions an anonymous first review
actions.mechanism: A separate review queue prevents arrival time, visible endorsements, and author identity from substituting for assessment.
actions.implementation: Show every unreviewed suggestion without authorship or endorsement counts. Use an explicitly disclosed shuffled order; restrict private authorship records to authorized access.
actions.check: Add a late alternative after endorsements accumulate. Verify it enters anonymous review and ordinary reviewers cannot retrieve its author through the API.
actions.risk: Distinctive wording may still reveal an author.

actions.action: Keep hard-constraint conflicts visible despite popularity
actions.mechanism: A constraint assessment remains independent of endorsements, making a popular but unsuitable name visibly unresolved rather than automatically rejected.
actions.implementation: Let users mark constraints as hard and record pass, conflict, or unknown with evidence. Display conflicts on cards without ranking or selecting names.
actions.check: Give a hard-constraint-violating name the most endorsements. Verify its conflict stays visible and no winner is declared.
actions.risk: Disputed assessments need explicit resolution rather than authoritative badges.

actions.mechanism: A duplicate claim must address the new rationale, not merely point to a similar earlier name.
actions.implementation: Replace one-click duplicate dismissal with a linked prior suggestion and an explanation covering the new rationale. Preserve both submissions; allow authors to contest equivalence.
actions.check: Submit two similar names solving different constraints. Verify a duplicate claim displays both rationales and can be disputed without restoring deleted content.
actions.risk: Additional review work may slow genuinely repetitive submissions.

actions.action: Expose unexplored directions in a constraint map
actions.mechanism: A direction-by-constraint view reveals gaps and competing approaches without turning attention or endorsements into ordering signals.
actions.implementation: Add a matrix with direction rows, constraint columns, and linked evidence for addressed, conflicted, or unknown cells. Use alphabetical ordering and no aggregate score.
actions.check: Create several wording variants in one direction and one distinct alternative. Verify both directions appear and variants do not multiply coverage.
actions.risk: A dense matrix may need accessible filtering and summaries.

actions.action: Carry unresolved dissent into decision summaries
actions.mechanism: Persistent dissent records prevent a human-made shortlist from being mistaken for unanimous agreement or comprehensive consideration.
actions.implementation: Let participants attach an unresolved objection and alternative to a shortlist. Include these records in exports; retain them until explicitly resolved with an explanation.
actions.check: Shortlist a popular name while another direction has an unresolved objection. Verify the summary and export retain that objection and linked alternative.
actions.risk: Unresolved objections must not become an indefinite veto.
